title: Just 400 US Data Centers Use More Electricity Than Michigan
summary:
Just 400 hyperscale data centers connected in the US used as much electricity as the state of Michigan in a single year, new Harvard research has found.
Federal and state governments do not track data center use separate from the rest of the power sector, despite mounting projections that data centers are putting serious strain on the American power grid.
Individual data centers’ power use is often considered proprietary business information, and data center operators and utilities do not have to disclose specific numbers to the public.
Developers are building campuses that are hundreds or even thousands of megawatts, and there are proposals for still larger data centers.
While the federal government hasn’t tracked data center energy use to date, that could change soon, and it could be a boon to researchers and the public.

title: Indonesian president apologises to Singapore, Malaysia for wildfire haze
summary:
⁠Indonesian President ⁠Prabowo Subianto has apologised to Singapore and Malaysia ⁠for the transboundary haze due to months-long wildfires.
The haze travelled to Malaysia and to Singapore.
Previously, an Indonesian official faced criticism after claiming the country’s forests supply oxygen to Malaysia and Singapore despite recurring haze from wildfires.
Prabowo’s remarks came as the problem of transboundary haze has begun to disappear.
On Thursday, the ASEAN Specialised Meteorological Centre (ASMC) issued a “no transboundary smoke haze” notice for southern parts of Southeast Asia, the Jakarta Post reported.
